title: 第六章 节操呢第七章 蹴鞠县令第八章 对赌
lines: 傅游艺的盘算是想着以朱恩这事儿为契机，将岳峰完全收为己用。
在他想来，岳峰和朱恩是拴在一条绳上的蚂蚱，朱恩遭难，岳峰岂能独活？傅游艺倘若能够替朱恩和岳峰化解危机，必能让岳峰感恩戴德！
傅游艺一辈子老谋深算，自诩最懂人心。可是今天遇到了岳峰，他的那一套不灵了，现在事情又紧急，不容他有任何耽搁。
因为朱恩已经落入了魏生明的手中，朱恩出事儿了，傅游艺能脱得了干系？
就算他仗着官身能不死，他此行的目的也必然打水漂了，他傅游艺苦熬了六十年，终于等来了一次契机，他绝不允许这样的机会被葬送。
当即，他立刻改变策略，拱手对岳峰道：“岳兄弟，我傅游艺打开天窗说亮话，这一次在驿站遇险，多亏兄弟相救！
傅某不才，能看出岳兄弟绝非凡人！你我既共过患难同过生死便是上天赐予的缘分，今日傅某诚心想和岳兄弟义结金兰，结为异性兄弟，还望岳兄弟不嫌弃我这个老大哥……”
“呃……我……”岳峰差点被这老小子给雷晕了，傅游艺这思维跳跃也太快了吧？刚刚还想着让自己感恩戴德，现在马上就要来义结金兰，亏他想得出来。
老小子自己六十岁了，已经是半截入土的人，岳峰今天才十八岁，两人义结金兰，不求同年同月生，只求同年同月同日死？这人还有底线吗？还有节操吗？
岳峰的记忆中，傅游艺虽然是个传奇，可结果似乎也不好，依旧没有逃脱酷吏的罗织诬告，最后被武则天杀了头。
岳峰倘若真和他义结金兰，回头傅游艺被砍头，岳峰怎么办？对傅游艺这样的当官狂热分子，岳峰真想保持一点距离。
他毫不犹豫，断然拒绝道：“别，别，岳大人！你我差着辈分，岂能乱了纲常？大人放心，现在您既然放出了话，说我是您的小书吏，我就给您干几年书吏，助大人大展宏图，好不好？”
“大人尽管放心，你我同过生死，还怕我害您不成？
“呃……”傅游艺被岳峰这话直接给怔住了，他绕了这么大一圈，其实就是这个目的，让岳峰能跟着他干，他绕了半天，岳峰一句话就解决了，只是……他还是有些遗憾……
“主薄大人，周县丞过来拜访您了！”外面的门子过来给傅游艺禀报，便听到外面一声朗笑传过来：
“傅师，可是我傅师来耶？本官俗事繁忙，没有及时给老师接风，罪过大了！”周县丞名周柔，生得面皮白净，仪表堂堂，听他的语气，竟然还是傅游艺的学生。
傅游艺甩开了岳峰，霎时老泪纵横，拽住周柔的手道：“周县丞啊！老朽不远数百里过来上任，就是听闻汝在这里啊！不瞒汝，老朽差点见不着汝了！”
周柔讶然道：“这是怎么回事？傅师为何这般说？”
傅游艺当即把驿所历险的经过说了一遍，周柔听得唏嘘不已，傅游艺又道：“周县丞，还有一事老朽心中觉得实在冤枉！魏县尉竟然不信老朽之言，把那不良人朱恩给抓了起来，严刑拷打，竟然要把秦捕头之死栽在不良人和我的书吏岳峰身上……”
“岳二郎，还不快过来见过县丞大人？”
岳峰连忙过来拜见周柔，周柔上下打量岳峰，赞道：“好壮士！稍后随我去办书吏手续，以后可要好好辅佐好我傅师！”
岳峰连连称是，傅游艺又把话题扯到了朱恩身上，说是他听到了小道消息，听说秦捕头其实和魏县尉后堂的一名宠娘子有私，定是这宠娘子给魏大人吹了枕边风，让魏生明下此狠手，非得要指鹿为马，给朱恩和岳峰罗织罪名。
周柔一听这番话，当即把六房书吏都叫过来，让他们去查一查，究竟是魏生明后宅中的哪一位小娘子和秦捕头有私，这一查一闹，县衙里面立刻掀起了极大的波澜，魏生明被秦捕头戴绿帽子，忏怒于不良人的消息县衙人尽皆知。
话说魏生明，他带着一众捕快去了一趟梓泽乡驿站，回来就把朱恩给抓进了大牢，秦厉云是他的小舅子，这个人是什么德行他能不知道？
倘若真在驿馆遭遇到了“浮逃”，秦厉云肯定不会那么容易死，如果打不赢，秦厉云胯下有快马，逃命无虞，再说了，区区五个浮逃，能奈何秦厉云的五名悍卒？漏洞实在太大了，他觉得事情有蹊跷。
魏生明残忍嗜血，朱恩落到了他的手上，他二话不说，先让人毒打一顿！朱恩咬紧牙关，一口咬死秦厉云是死于“浮逃”之手，气得魏生明杀机乍起，他还待继续上酷刑，外面“绿帽子”的消息便传开了。
县衙三班皆觉得面上无光，魏生明也气得捶胸顿足，七窍生烟，然而，他压根不准备放人，反而将两个班头叫过来，厉声道：“这姓朱的一定有问题，那个姓岳的也必然有事儿！甚至傅游艺也有嫌疑，这些传言乃惑人耳目，越是如此，越说明他们心虚，尔等给我牢牢的守住这姓朱的小子，我亲自去见县令大人！”
魏生明这边的消息传到了县衙，岳峰直接傻了眼，他本以为傅游艺这一手定然能管用，没想到魏生明竟然不是个善茬，难怪史书将武朝的酷吏写得如此可怖，原来还真难对付，这姓魏的着实是个狠角色，被他咬一口，入木三分啊！
当今大唐的官员，要么是傅游艺之流，时时刻刻寻觅良机，准备劝进拍马，或者是献祥瑞，凭此得富贵！另外一种就是魏生明这种酷吏，靠着整人罗织罪名，构陷武氏的异己，为武则天称帝铺平道路。除此之外，其他的官员根本没有生存的空间。
魏生明如此狠辣，真为了给小舅子报仇？说不定他听到了“绿帽子”的传言，心中已经把秦厉云给恨透了呢！他的目的是让自己的酷吏名头大噪，从而上达天听，现在正活跃在朝堂上的来俊臣，周兴之流，不都是名头大噪之后被委以重任的吗？
傅游艺也略略有点意外，他虽然狡猾如狐，但毕竟是初来乍到，对上了魏生明这种在合宫县经营了很久的酷吏还是很吃力，甚至魏生明的最终目标极有可能是他呢！
“岳峰壮士，事已至此，我们的事情恐怕捂不住了，为今之计只有你我各自逃命去了！”傅游艺对岳峰道。
岳峰道：“傅大人，我们在驿所的时候经历的也是九死一生，如今就算被魏生明得逞，也不过一死而已，又有什么可怕的？
傅大人胸怀大志，关键时候肯定能有应对之策，岳某唯大人马首是瞻！”
傅游艺哈哈一笑，他本就只是试探一下岳峰，没想到岳峰又没吃他这一套，他只好顿了顿足道：“如今唯一的生路在县令身上！但是魏生明是县令的爱将，这一关恐怕不好过……”
傅游艺说难，县丞周柔急匆匆的跑过来，也是一脸的紧张，道：“傅师，事情到了这一步，躲能躲得了么？为今之计，只有我们一起去见县令，而后见机行事！”
content_en:
Fu Youyi's plan was to use Zhu En's incident as an opportunity to completely take Yue Feng into his own hands.
In his mind, Yue Feng and Zhu En were like grasshoppers tied to the same rope. If Zhu En suffered, how could Yue Feng survive alone? If Fu Youyi can resolve the crisis for Zhu En and Yue Feng, Yue Feng will definitely be grateful!
Fu Youyi has been scheming all his life and prides himself on understanding people's hearts best. But when he met Yue Feng today, his trick didn't work. Now the matter was urgent and he was not allowed to delay.
Because Zhu En has fallen into the hands of Wei Shengming, if something happens to Zhu En, can Fu Youyi get away with it?
Even if he could survive relying on his official position, the purpose of his trip would definitely be in vain. He Fu Youyi had been struggling for sixty years and finally waited for an opportunity. He would never allow such an opportunity to be ruined.
Immediately, he immediately changed his strategy, raised his hands and said to Yue Feng: "Brother Yue, I, Fu Youyi, opened the skylight and spoke frankly. This time I was in danger at the inn, thanks to my brother for saving me!
Fu is not talented, but he can tell that Brother Yue is an extraordinary person! It is a fate given by God that you and I have shared life and death together. Today, Fu Moucheng sincerely wants to marry brother-in-law and become brothers of the opposite sex. I hope brother-in-law will not dislike me as a big brother..."
"Uh...I..." Yue Feng was almost stunned by this old boy. Wasn't Fu Youyi's thinking jumping too fast? Just now he was thinking of being grateful, but now he was about to marry Jin Lan, but he couldn't think of it.
The old boy himself is sixty years old and is already half dead. Yue Feng is only eighteen years old today. The two of them are married to Jinlan. They don't want to be born in the same year and the same month, but they just want to die in the same year, the same month and the same day? Does this person have any bottom line? Do you still have moral integrity?
In Yue Feng's memory, although Fu Youyi was a legend, the result seemed not to be good. He still did not escape the cruel accusation of Luo Zhi, and was eventually beheaded by Wu Zetian.
If Yue Feng really becomes sworn brother to Jinlan and Fu Youyi is beheaded, what will Yue Feng do? Yue Feng really wanted to keep a little distance from official fanatics like Fu Youyi.
He did not hesitate and flatly refused: "No, no, Mr. Yue! How can we mess up the rules because of the difference in seniority between you and me? Don't worry, sir. Now that you have said that I am your little scribe, I will work as a scribe for you for a few years to help you develop your ambitions, okay?"
"Don't worry, sir. You and I will live and die together. Are you still afraid that I will harm you?
"Uh..." Fu Youyi was immediately stunned by Yue Feng's words. The purpose of his detour was to allow Yue Feng to follow him. After detouring for a long time, Yue Feng solved the problem in just one sentence, but... he still felt a little regretful...
"Lord Bo, Prime Minister Zhou County has come to visit you! "The doorman outside came over to report to Fu Youyi, and heard a loud laugh coming from outside:
"Master, my master is here? I am busy with my secular affairs, so I did not catch up with the teacher in time. What a big sin! "The Prime Minister of Zhou County is named Zhou Rou. He is fair-skinned and handsome. Judging from his tone, he is actually a student of Fu Youyi.
Fu Youyi threw Yue Feng away and burst into tears. She grabbed Zhou Rou's hand and said, "Zhou Xiancheng! I came hundreds of miles away to take office just because I heard that you are here! To tell you the truth, I almost lost my sight of you! "
Zhou Rou said in surprise: "What's going on? Why did Master say this? "
Fu Youyi immediately told the story of the post's adventure, and Zhou Rou was filled with sighs. Fu Youyi said again: "Zhou Xian Cheng, there is another matter that I feel I am really unjust! Wei County Lieutenant actually didn't believe the old man's words and arrested the bad guy Zhu En and tortured him severely. He actually wanted to blame the bad guy and my scribe Yue Feng for the death of Qin Captou..."
"Yue Erlang, why don't you come over quickly and meet the county magistrate? "
Yue Feng quickly came over to meet Zhou Rou. Zhou Rou looked Yue Feng up and down and praised: "What a strong man! Follow me to go through the clerical formalities later, and you must assist my master well from now on! "
Yue Feng repeatedly said yes, and Fu Youyi brought the topic to Zhu En again, saying that he had heard rumors that Capt. Qin was actually having an affair with a favorite lady in the Weihou Hall in Wei County. This beloved lady must have given Mr. Wei the wind and made Wei Shengming do this ruthlessly. He had to blame Zhu En and Yue Feng for it.
As soon as Zhou Rou heard this, she immediately called all the clerks in the six rooms over and asked them to find out which young lady in Wei Shengming's back house was having an affair with Capt. Qin. This investigation immediately caused a huge stir in the county government. The news that Wei Shengming was cuckolded by Capt. Qin and confessed his anger to the bad guy was known to everyone in the county government.
Speaking of Wei Shengming, he took a group of detectives to the Zize Township Inn, and when he came back, he arrested Zhu En and put him in jail. Qin Liyun was his brother-in-law. How could he not know what kind of virtue this man had?
If he really encounters a "floating escape" in the post house, Qin Liyun will definitely not die so easily. If he can't win, Qin Liyun has a fast horse at his hip, so he can escape with his life. Besides, what can a mere five floating escapes do to Qin Liyun's five warriors? The loopholes were so big that he felt something was fishy.
Wei Shengming was cruel and bloodthirsty, and Zhu En fell into his hands. Without saying a word, he was beaten severely! Zhu En gritted his teeth and bit Qin Liyun to death because he died at the hands of "Fleeing". Wei Shengming was so angry that he suddenly had murderous intentions. Before he could continue the torture, the news of "cuckolding" spread outside.
The third class of the county government all felt that their faces were dishonored, and Wei Shengming was so angry that he beat his chest and smoked from his orifices. However, he was not ready to let him go. Instead, he called the two class leaders over and said sternly: "There must be something wrong with this guy named Zhu, and there must be something wrong with that guy named Yue!" Even Fu Youyi is suspected. These rumors are misleading. The more so, the more it shows that they are guilty. You guys, please keep this boy surnamed Zhu firmly under your control. I will go see the county magistrate myself! "
The news about Wei Shengming reached the county government, and Yue Feng was dumbfounded. He thought that Fu Youyi's move would definitely work, but he didn't expect that Wei Shengming was not a good person. No wonder the history books described the cruel officials of the Wu Dynasty as so terrifying. It turned out that they were really difficult to deal with. This person surnamed Wei was really a ruthless character, and one bite from him would be devastating!
Today's officials in the Tang Dynasty are either Fu Youyi and others, who are always looking for good opportunities, ready to persuade people to marry, or to offer auspicious auspiciousness, so as to gain wealth! The other type is a cruel official like Wei Shengming, who relies on persecuting people and fabricating accusations to frame Wu's dissidents and pave the way for Wu Zetian to become emperor. Apart from this, there is no room for other officials to survive.
Wei Shengming is so ruthless, is he really trying to avenge his brother-in-law? Maybe he heard the rumors of "cuckold" and already hated Qin Liyun in his heart! His purpose is to make his cruel officials famous so that they can reach heaven. Aren't Lai Junchen, Zhou Xing and others who are currently active in the court all entrusted with important responsibilities after becoming famous?
Fu Youyi was also a little surprised. Although he was as cunning as a fox, he was new here after all. It was still difficult to deal with a cruel official like Wei Shengming who had been operating in Hegong County for a long time. Wei Shengming's ultimate target was very likely to be him!
"Mr. Yue Feng, the matter has come to this. I'm afraid we can no longer cover up our affairs. For now, we have to escape for our lives!" Fu Youyi said to Yue Feng.
Yue Feng said: "Master Fu, what we experienced when we were in the post house was a narrow escape from death. Now even if Wei Shengming succeeds, it will only be one death. What's so scary?
Mr. Fu has great ambitions and will definitely have countermeasures at critical moments. Mr. Yue can only follow his lead! "
Fu Youyi laughed. He was just testing Yue Feng, but he didn't expect Yue Feng to fall for him again. He had to pause and said: "The only way out now is the county magistrate! But Wei Shengming is the county magistrate's favorite general, so I'm afraid this will not be easy..."
Fu Youyi said it was difficult, and the county magistrate Zhou Rou hurried over, with a nervous look on his face, and said: "Master, when things have reached this point, can we hide? For the current plan, we are the only ones to go to the county magistrate together, and then act according to the situation!"
